name: Android Development Environment
updateContentCommand: mkdir -p $HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && cd $HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && curl -O https://google.com && unzip *.zip && mv cmdline-tools latest || true
postCreateCommand: export ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/android-sdk && export PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools && yes | sdkmanager --licenses && sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
